message: module `{module}`: this divides two integers; Verilog-A truncates the quotient (7 / 2 = 3), this simulator does not (3.5)
description: Retired in 2.39.0, which implements integer division: a division of two integers now truncates as the LRM says, so there is nothing left to warn about and the code is no longer emitted. Codes are never reused. From 2.36.0 to 2.38.x it reported a division of two integer-typed operands, which this simulator then divided in real arithmetic (7 / 2 gave 3.5 instead of 3).
actions: Nothing to do on 2.39.0 or later. On 2.36.x-2.38.x, write `int(a / b)` for the integer quotient, or `a / 2.0` for a real one.
